title: AI has come for Arizona’s water
slides: Who's really thirsty in Arizona: AI or you?
Data centers now rival farms for water rights
One ChatGPT query can sip a bottle's worth
Your utility bill may soon fund new AI cooling
Ask your water board who's next in line
thread_text:
1. AI or you?

Arizona data centers now compete with farms for water rights. The same tap you drink from may soon cool a server.

2. Farms no longer first

For decades, agriculture had priority. Now tech giants buy water rights directly, changing who gets served first.

3. One query, one bottle

A single ChatGPT prompt can consume as much water as a plastic bottle. Multiply that by millions of daily users.

4. Your bill funds cooling

Utility companies are investing in new infrastructure for AI cooling. Those costs often get passed to residential customers.

5. Who's next in line?

Ask your local water board how data centers are prioritized. Then check your next utility bill for new line items.
